description: This file defines the GroupPosBased class, which extends RegexBasedAbstract, and is part of the FastRoute data generator component. It provides methods for processing route regexes and generating route maps based on position-based grouping strategies.

classes.name: GroupPosBased
classes.description: A class for generating route patterns based on position grouping in the FastRoute library.

methods.name: getApproxChunkSize
methods.description: Returns an approximate chunk size for route processing, fixed at 10.

methods.name: processChunk
methods.description: Processes a map of regex to route data, constructing a combined regex and a route mapping based on regex offsets.
